name: Midea multi head system
tagline: One outdoor unit for up to six rooms, with four indoor unit types.
summary: Midea's inverter multi split system connects up to six independently controlled indoor units to one outdoor unit, saving outdoor space and letting you heat or cool only the rooms you need.
Five outdoor unit sizes pair with wall mounted, ducted, compact cassette and floor console indoor units.

image.alt: Midea multi head system outdoor unit with four wall-mounted indoor units

highlights.title: Up to six rooms
highlights.text: One outdoor unit connects to as many as six indoor units, each with its own control.

highlights.title: Four indoor types
highlights.text: Combine wall mounted, ducted, compact cassette and floor console units.

highlights.title: Efficient at part load
highlights.text: Runs at partial output when only some rooms are in use, using up to 30% less energy.

highlights.title: Steady temperature
highlights.text: Midea's inverter control keeps room temperature stable to within ±0.5°C.

highlights.title: Wi-Fi app control
highlights.text: Adjust wall mounted and floor console units remotely from the Midea mobile app.

highlights.title: Automatic wiring correction
highlights.text: The system automatically corrects crossed wiring and piping connections after installation.

specs.label: Outdoor unit sizes
specs.value: Five, for up to 2 to 6 indoor units

specs.label: Max. pipe length for all rooms
specs.value: 40 m to 80 m, depending on model
